title: Demolition Permit
name: Demolition Permit
description: Permit for demolition and dismantling activities covering structural surveys, services, asbestos, engineered sequence, stability, exclusion zones and close-out.

sections.title: PRE-DEMOLITION INFORMATION AND SURVEYS
items: Available structural drawings, alterations and historic information have been reviewed
A suitable structural survey / engineering assessment has established the form, condition and load paths
Adjacent and connected structures have been assessed for stability implications
Asbestos information is suitable for the planned intrusive demolition work
Other hazardous materials and contaminated areas have been identified
Below-ground and overhead services in or near the demolition zone have been identified
The condition and capacity of floors / slabs proposed for demolition plant have been verified

sections.title: SERVICES AND ISOLATIONS
items: Electrical, gas, water, telecoms, process and other services have been identified
Services requiring isolation or disconnection have been made safe before demolition starts
Isolation / disconnection has been verified and appropriately labelled or recorded
Services that must remain live are clearly identified and physically protected
Underground services are included in the demolition and plant movement plan

fields.label: Services Remaining Live and Protection Measures
Linked LOTO / Electrical Isolation Permit References

sections.title: ENGINEERED DEMOLITION METHOD AND STABILITY
items: The demolition method and sequence have been prepared by a competent person and reviewed by an appropriate engineer where required
The sequence maintains structural stability at every stage
Temporary supports, propping or restraint required for stability have been designed and controlled as temporary works
Debris accumulation and plant loading will not overload floors or remaining structure
Unplanned collapse cannot breach the defined site / exclusion boundary
Changes to the demolition method or sequence require competent review before work continues

sections.title: EXCLUSION, DEBRIS AND PUBLIC PROTECTION
items: Safe working zones, exclusion zones and debris zones are defined for the current demolition phase
Barriers and access control prevent unauthorised entry
The exclusion zone accounts for foreseeable falling / projecting debris and structural collapse
Plant and pedestrian routes are segregated or controlled
Adjacent roads, footpaths, occupied premises and neighbours are protected where applicable
Scaffolding is not being relied upon as structural support unless specifically designed for that purpose

fields.label: Exclusion / Debris Zone Description and Dimensions

sections.title: DUST, NOISE, FIRE AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROLS
items: Dust suppression is suitable for the demolition method and hazardous material risks
Noise and vibration controls protect workers, neighbours and sensitive structures where required
Hot work, fuel, gas cylinders and ignition sources are separately controlled where applicable
Waste streams are segregated and hazardous waste is handled through authorised routes
Run-off, contaminated water and debris cannot enter drains or the wider environment uncontrolled
Emergency arrangements cover collapse, fire, service strike and plant incidents

sections.title: PRE-START AUTHORIZATION AND DAILY REVIEW
items: The current demolition phase matches the approved method and sequence
Structural condition has not changed in a way that invalidates the planned method
Required temporary supports, barriers and isolations are in place
Weather conditions are suitable for the method, plant and structure
The demolition team has been briefed on the current sequence, exclusion zones and emergency arrangements

sections.title: COMPLETION AND HAND-BACK
items: Demolition has stopped at a stable and safe condition
Remaining structures and temporary supports have been inspected
Debris, protrusions, openings and exposed edges have been made safe
Services and below-ground hazards are safely terminated or clearly recorded
The area is secure and suitable for the next work phase
